ground_truth: Source-assisted manual visual review, not independent human listening truth.
method: Twenty fixed 12s cores plus250ms margins, selected before inspecting detector output. All complete master overviews reviewed by worker and lead; lead additionally inspected four raw detail sheets, compared fixed bounds, manual onset brackets and source/cached-evidence hashes. Margins participate in matching. Ambiguities use the existing -70ms/+200ms exclusion rule. Two Late Night cores remain unscorable; their contents are not training negatives. Four Miracle/Heavy cores are accepted only with the explicitly listed bounded uncertainties, retaining sustained/modulated bass negatives elsewhere. All prior174 labels are unchanged.
timing: Midpoints of visually bracketed raw waveform onsets; intervals25–50ms wide quantify localization uncertainty, not statistical confidence. Centred STFT corroborates identity but is not an onset clock. No BPM, detector output, lag fitting, warp or additional delay. Documented Midnight+0.136375s source offset only.
